platform: WMUA 91.1 UMass Music Communications and Archival Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WMUA's current staff page says the Music Communications Director is the contact for artists submitting music and the Archival Music Director manages physical and digital music submissions. The role links are non-plaintext/protected and the station does not publish complete file, link, package or metadata requirements. A human must open only the visible official contact route, confirm the accepted delivery method, select suitable clean audio and metadata, and avoid decoding or guessing contact details.

platform: WRIU 90.3 Rhode Island Genre Music Director Digital and Physical Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WRIU explicitly accepts digital submissions through the appropriate genre department and physical submissions addressed to the relevant Music Director. The RPM/Electronic, World and Reggae contact links are rendered as protected/non-plaintext email routes. A human must choose one correct department, use only the official visible link, confirm file or download-link expectations, prepare release metadata and clean versions, and avoid duplicate multi-department outreach.

platform: WRUW-FM 91.1 Case Western Music Director Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
manual_review_reason: WRUW's current Executive Staff page identifies the Music Director through a protected email link, while the public site does not publish complete unsolicited-music delivery rules. A human must use only the official visible contact link to send a concise asset-free routing inquiry, confirm whether digital or physical submissions are accepted, and wait for explicit instructions before supplying audio, links or files.

platform: WUNH 91.3 University of New Hampshire Physical Music Director Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WUNH publishes a physical Music Director mailing route, states that every submission is heard but airplay is not guaranteed, and asks submitters not to request status updates. The same contact page contains an Executive Officer form with a human-verification question and its listed officer data differs from the current 2026-27 board. A human must use the generic Music Director postal address, verify package contents and current release eligibility, and must not automate or bypass the form challenge.

platform: WVKR 91.3 Vassar Music Director and Genre Email or Promotional CD Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WVKR publishes a direct Music Director email, genre-specific contacts including World Music, and a promotional-CD postal route. A human must select the single best route, prepare a concise pitch and release information, verify file or link accessibility before email delivery, or prepare a correctly addressed CD package while accepting that submitted CDs cannot be returned.
